Invoices generated for companies outside UTC could display an incorrect issue date (often one day ahead or behind) because the date was calculated in server local time rather than the account’s configured timezone.

Solution
• Propagate account.timezone into InvoiceRenderer so all computations use the correct tz.
• Replace naive datetime objects with timezone-aware ones created via pytz / pendulum.
• Added regression tests for UTC-05:00, UTC+09:00 and DST boundaries to prevent future regressions.

Impact
Ensures invoice PDFs and CSV exports now always show the expected local date, eliminating customer confusion and support tickets.

Closes #212
